validatorRequirements.description: Reject implemented routes without exactly one client-contract operation record or without semantic and interface authority mapping.
Reject missing or inconsistent operation metadata for auth, tenant, validation, error, audit, telemetry, implementation, and proof fields.
Reject stale, unknown, or unsupported generated-client input status.
Reject generated-client, SDK, UI, public API, deployment, staging, production, live-provider, or human-acceptance readiness overclaims and UI-invented behaviour.
